title: Extend GF(p) fgemm benchmarks + dispatch to n=4096 (026fc832 Phase 6)
description:
Phase 6 independent task under epic `026fc832`. Extends the existing GF(p) fgemm benchmarks and dispatch to cover n=4096 cells.

Parent epic: `026fc832`. Predecessor: `41096af5` (route-A wire-in at n≥512).

## Background

A8 rows 1-3 (fgemm GF(7/31/65521) at n=4096) currently FAIL at 1.70-2.52× vs fflas. The existing fp_small SIMD path scales to n=4096 but has not been benchmarked there since 027fc832 began. Likely closes with the existing infrastructure (route-A for GF(251), Candidate C for others). If not, scoping note in evidence doc.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] 5-trial CCX1-pinned benchmarks at GF(7), GF(31), GF(127), GF(241), GF(251), GF(65521) at n=4096 on the 5900X reference host, recorded as CSV + evidence doc.
- [hard] For every (prime, n=4096) cell measured, the post-bench evidence doc records the ratio vs fflas-ffpack and either marks PASS (≤ 1.5×) or escalates with the gap.
- [hard] No regression on existing (prime, n) cells PASSing post-`41096af5` (delta ≤ 5%).
- [hard] If route-A is found to be the optimal path for any (prime, n=4096) cell, the `select_f32_path` dispatch is updated to route accordingly (with the same testing rigor as `41096af5`).
- [hard] Bit-exact correctness preserved (proptest sweep extended to n=4096 for at least GF(251); other primes covered by inheritance from the dispatch logic verified at smaller n).

## Out of scope

- Other phases (PLE, echelon, invert, solve).
- AVX-512 (epic `7f809931`).

## Notes

Independent of the dense-LA design/impl track. Can run in parallel with the design tasks. Light implementation: existing kernels should scale; the work is benchmark + optional dispatch refinement.
